create_BoundedLogWriter: create a BoundedLogWriter to asynchronously write and rotate JSONL log files when they exceed a size limit
run_log_process: run log_process to read background process output and persist it to a JSONL log file with automatic rotation
read_log_entries: read log entries from a JSONL log file with offset and tail support, returning entries, total count, and truncation status
tail_log_recent: tail the last n entries from a JSONL log file using a reverse-read strategy to avoid loading the whole file into memory
review_BoundedLogWriter_flush: review the BoundedLogWriter class and its configurable flush_interval and flush_buffer for reducing I/O pressure
